question: For which region was the direction of trade (in terms of India’s imports in Rs. Crore) for 2016- 17 the maximum?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Asia and ASEAN.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** ASEAN group of countries** includes **Brunei Darussalam, Cambodia, Lao People's Democratic Republic, Malaysia, Myanmar, Philippines, Singapore, Thailand, and Viet Nam.**
 
• For the years** 2016–17**, the ASEAN region's** import trade** with India was** 40.62 USD billion. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Direction of foreign trade **means the countries to which India** exports its goods** and the countries from** which it imports.**
 
• As a result, direction is determined by the** sources and destinations** of our imports and exports.
 
• **India's commerce** contributed **40.08 percent of its GDP in 2016 **to the overall economy.
 
• The percentage of GDP devoted to** trade in services was 11.23.**
 
• From** April-September 2022**, India's merchandise **exports** were at** US$ 231.88 billion, a 16.96% rise** as compared to the same period previous year.
 
• From **April-September 2022,** India's imports totalled **US$ 380.34 billion, a 38.55% rise** as compared to the same period previous year.
